description:
The action type is called **UserRegistrationAction**. It is defined as an action representing the registration of a new user in the system, and the public flag is set to **true**, meaning the action type is available to everybody. Its unique identifier is the URL **https://example.org/schemas/actions/user-registration**.

The payload expected by this action follows the JSON‑Schema draft‑04 meta‑schema (**http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#**) and is titled **“User Registration Payload.”** The payload must be a JSON object containing the required properties **username**, **email**, and **password**; no other properties are permitted. The **username** field must be a string between 3 and 30 characters long, matching the regular expression `^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$`. The **email** field must be a string formatted as an email address. The **password** field must be a string of at least 8 characters. An optional **referralCode** field may be provided; if present it must be a string matching the pattern `^[A-Z0-9]{6}$`. All additional properties are disallowed.
